description: Merge review AIUI-1 (12.04). The Warboss is the LAST unit owed a fight; the player selects it through the fighter-selection panel, so the sequencer already reports the Fight step as over, and then clicks 'End Fight Phase' while the Warboss is still mid-activation. The phase refuses END_FIGHT ('still fighting'); before the fix single-player Main fell back to PhaseManager.advance_to_next_phase() on that refusal, so one click skipped the Warboss's attacks, the Consolidate step and the end-of-Fight triggers and jumped to Scoring. Now the refusal stands: the phase stays in the Fight step, the Warboss is still the active fighter and an error toast says why. Setup-only privileges: CP zeroed (no stratagem prompts), model wounds raised, and every OTHER owed fight marked resolved so the Warboss is the last one.

steps.comment: setup privilege: every OTHER owed fight is marked resolved — the Warboss is the last unit owed a fight
the trap: nobody is left to SELECT, so Main's 12.04 pre-check lets the click through

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: still the Fight phase — before the fix the refusal fell back to advance_to_next_phase (Scoring)
the Warboss's fight is not thrown away
